::: {.callout-note title="Statement of Inquiry · 单元探究命题" icon=false}
**Mountains and seas shaped new {{< vocab "republic" >}}s and citizen assemblies, yet public freedom stayed anchored to {{< vocab "social hierarchy" >}} and forced labour.**

“地理环境深刻塑造了治理系统；然而制度在根本上都未能脱离阶层分化与强迫劳动的基石。”

**Key Concept:** Systems (系统与制度) · **Related Concepts:** Governance (治理), Causality (因果关系), Civilization (文明) · **Global Context:** Fairness and Development (公平与发展)
:::
